_meta.note: Curated offline subset of MITRE ATLAS mitigations mapped to LLM, agentic, and ML techniques.

mitigations.name: Limit Model Artifact Release
mitigations.description: Minimize public disclosure of internal architecture, weights, and system details.

mitigations.name: Passive ML Output Obfuscation
mitigations.description: Suppress raw confidence scores, logits, and unnecessary metadata from inference responses.

mitigations.name: Model Hardening
mitigations.description: Use adversarial training or robustification so small perturbations do not flip decisions.

mitigations.name: Restrict Number of AI Model Queries
mitigations.description: Enforce rate limits, quotas, and anomaly detection on inference API callers.

mitigations.name: Control Access to ML Models and Data at Rest
mitigations.description: Apply strict IAM and storage controls to model weights, training sets, and vector indices.

mitigations.name: Use Ensemble Methods
mitigations.description: Combine independent detectors or models to reduce single-model transferability.

mitigations.name: Sanitize Training Data
mitigations.description: Inspect, deduplicate, and filter training, fine-tuning, and RAG ingestion corpora.

mitigations.name: Validate ML Model
mitigations.description: Test models on held-out red-team and backdoor evaluation suites prior to deployment.

mitigations.name: Input Restoration
mitigations.description: Normalize, canonicalize, and strip obfuscated encodings or invisible characters before inference.

mitigations.name: Restrict Library Loading
mitigations.description: Disallow unsafe deserialization formats (such as pickle) and restrict dynamic imports.

mitigations.name: Encrypt Sensitive Information
mitigations.description: Encrypt secrets, credentials, and sensitive datasets at rest and keep them out of prompts.

mitigations.name: Code Signing
mitigations.description: Require cryptographic signatures for model artifacts, plugins, and MCP servers.

mitigations.name: Verify ML Artifacts
mitigations.description: Verify checksums, provenance, and SBOMs for third-party models, datasets, and packages.

mitigations.name: Adversarial Input Detection
mitigations.description: Screen user prompts, retrieved RAG chunks, and tool results for prompt-injection patterns.

mitigations.name: Vulnerability Scanning
mitigations.description: Scan dependencies, wrappers, and container images for known vulnerabilities.

mitigations.name: User Training
mitigations.description: Train operators and users to recognize indirect prompt injection and AI phishing lures.

mitigations.name: Control Access to AI Models and Data in Production
mitigations.description: Enforce tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization on AI endpoints and RAG indices.

mitigations.name: Generative AI Guardrails
mitigations.description: Enforce input/output validation, response sanitization, and tool-invocation policies around LLMs.

mitigations.name: Generative AI Guidelines
mitigations.description: Structure system prompts with explicit instruction hierarchy, delimiters, and anti-extraction rules.

mitigations.name: Generative AI Model Alignment
mitigations.description: Select or fine-tune models aligned to respect instruction hierarchy and resist jailbreaks.

mitigations.name: AI Telemetry Logging
mitigations.description: Log prompts, tool calls, and anomalous agent state transitions for auditing and detection.

mitigations.name: Human-in-the-Loop
mitigations.description: Require explicit human approval before agents execute destructive or outbound actions.

mitigations.name: Enforce Principle of Least Privilege
mitigations.description: Restrict agent tools, file paths, network destinations, and data scopes to the minimum required.
